blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said Wednesday he would ask Vice Mayor Jeryll Harold Respicio of Reina Mercedes, Isabela to undergo a drug test following an outburst during a Sangguniang Bayan session. “Ipapa-drug test ko muna. Parang wala sa sarili eh. Ayun lang. I advise him we will give him a drug test kasi mukhang adik eh yung asal niya eh,” said Remulla during an ambush interview. (I’ll have him undergo a drug test first. He seems out of his mind. That’s all. I advise that we give him a drug test because his behavior looks like that of […]...
